newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree unit sets credit card program.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree unit sets credit card program.

text.p: Green Tree Financial Corp said Friday its Green Tree Retail Services unit signed an agreement to provide a private-label credit card for use in Leath Furniture LLC stores.

Green Tree said the new credit card will be valid at 39 Leath and Modernage furniture stores in Indiana, Illinois, Iowa, Michigan, Wisconsin and Florida. Leath expects to expand its consumer finance business in 1997, Green Tree said.
Green Tree is a diversified financial services company whose Retail Services unit offers credit processing services to merchants and their customers.
The company's shares closed up 1-1/8 Friday at 36-7/8.
